summary: Core's submodule carries staged, never-committed proto edits (SyncMode/CascadeErrorMode/MergeStrategy renumbered with UNSPECIFIED=0, route_to_handler->skip_handler, basis_seq) that core's working tree depends on; peers still send old numbers (SIMPLE=1 decodes as ASYNC, STRICT=1 as COMMUTATIVE, DECISION=3 as CASCADE).
post_persist bundles bus publish with sync projector/saga/PM calls; any downstream error republishes up to 3x, DLQs the book as unpublished and returns Ok with no projections.
CASCADE cannot fail fast: SagaRetryBuilder returns (), SagaCoord returns an empty OK, and CascadeErrorMode is written but never read.
A PM command classified Retryable outside DECISION is logged and dropped (no retry, DLQ or error) after PM state is persisted, so redelivery never re-emits it.

SIMPLE/CASCADE call ProjectorCoordinatorService.HandleSync on every component=projector Service, but no core bin serves it, chart projector Services point at the client container (ProjectorService) and the prj-* crates that implement it ship no binary; only NotFound is skipped, so UNIMPLEMENTED becomes Internal and feeds the post_persist DLQ path.

COMMUTATIVE (the default, wire 0) behaves as STRICT: pre-validation rejects any mismatch with retryable FAILED_PRECONDITION before load, the field-diff reflection pool is only initialised in the status bin, and the spec itself contradicts types.proto on what COMMUTATIVE means; MANUAL never reaches its DLQ for client commands.

The saga/PM sequencing model is undecided: saga.proto says the framework stamps angzarr_deferred, features require clients to stamp explicit sequences (erasing rejection provenance in the same oneof), and core never populates destination_sequences so basis_seq is always 0.
HandleSyncSpeculative AsOfTime passes an untyped "{secs}.{nanos}" string into a path that parses RFC3339, so every as-of-time speculation fails INTERNAL.
Instrumented<T> wraps every production store but does not forward get_with_divergence, so explicit-divergence edition loads without a snapshot always get NotImplemented.

Two main-timeline sentinels ("" and "angzarr"): Bigtable/Dynamo/ImmuDB write under "" but read main as "angzarr", so aggregate replay returns empty history and the next write conflicts forever; the spec itself names both.

pmg-reservation stamps explicit Sequence(0) on commands (skipping angzarr_deferred and idempotency) and on process events; on any non-empty target the command fails FAILED_PRECONDITION and the async PM drops it, and a second process event per correlation would conflict.

Projector HandleSpeculative ("no side effects") is broken at every layer: prj-event persists rows, ProjectorCoord and client-rust call the real handler, and core's bus handler returns an empty Projection without ever calling HandleSpeculative.
CASCADE both publishes to the bus and calls sagas/PMs synchronously, so each runs twice; PM triggers have no dedup.
PM event persist succeeds but bus publish failure is only logged (no DLQ capture); PM path also skips snapshots and upcasting.
tokio Mutex guards held across RPC awaits serialize business, saga/PM and upcaster calls per sidecar (possible deadlock on cyclic cascades, not reproduced).
Stream subscribers silently lose events once 32 are buffered (same code in core StreamService).
2PC is half-built: nothing writes Confirmation, CascadeReaper is never constructed and cascade_id never propagates, so events written under a cascade_id stay invisible forever.
The cascade conflict gate counts own/confirmed/revoked cascades as locked and replays raw markers; its Conflict path has no test (cited merge.test.rs does not exist).
speculative_mode and the fact pipeline skip the 2PC transform (and speculative ignores divergence), so they see raw unresolved pages.
The fact pipeline publishes NoOp books, propagates post-persist errors and skips correlation validation.
Triggers that emit commands without PM events reuse the same deferred idempotency key, so destinations swallow later commands as cached.
Sequence mismatches retry the identical book up to 10x (plus saga-level retries), while the overlap message is misclassified non-retryable.
The commutative/deferred overlap window loses intervening changes when a snapshot is newer than expected.
Every production snapshot is RETENTION_DEFAULT and no store prunes DEFAULT (Bigtable prunes nothing), so snapshots grow unbounded.
GetEvents ignores query.selection and edition validation, always streaming the full current book.
AggregateService never checks cover.domain against its TARGET domain, so facts/commands for any domain are persisted into its store.
persist_events writes to the business-returned cover, so a buggy client can append to another aggregate while the snapshot goes to the requested root.
CASCADE opens a new channel per saga/PM call with no deadline.
Fact injection always uses SyncMode::Async.
A fact carrying a client cascade_id on a committed page can mask a stale cascade from the (unwired) reaper.
Duplicate deferred-to-SourceInfo helpers disagree on bad-UUID handling.
PM rejection-routing cover has edition None, so branch rejections route to the main-timeline PM.
PM state lookup picks the first book from a HashMap and defaults edition to a third sentinel "main".
Synchronize skips validation and GetAggregateRoots lists only main-edition roots and swallows per-domain errors.
Upcaster responses are trusted without checking page count/sequences.
Weak tests: saga grpc tests assert literals, Mock stores skip contract macros, prj tests assert nothing on failure paths, binding conformance collapses the two-compensator case.
History/ticket commentary in protos, features and core code violates the no-change-commentary rule.

Dead core surface: src/process, ProjectorCoord, StreamService, AggregateCommandHandler, registration, client_traits, GapFiller, CommandBus, bus::Instrumented aliases, legacy storage inventory + ImmuDB, unused utils/DLQ helpers and metrics.
Core doc drift (CASCADE 'no bus', execute_atomic, embedded mode, Prepare phase, removed backends, README keys, Aborted retryable, example config keys).
Dotted subscription types must equal the full type_url and tokens are not trimmed.
